name: 05b - Demo workflow that fails on purpose

parameters.content:
## Failing demo
Stops on purpose when a lead is missing an email, so you can watch the error handler (05a) react.
**Setup:** 1) Import and publish 05a first. 2) In THIS workflow: ⋯ menu → Settings → **Error workflow** → choose 05a, save. 3) Click **Publish**. 4) Open http://localhost:5678/webhook/fail-demo in your browser. 5) Open 05a → **Executions** to see the alert.
Error workflows only fire on published (production) runs, not on manual test clicks.
